name: Belgium
notes: Scope: national (federal parliament, parties, unions, economists, NGOs), 3 regions (Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels), 10 provinces, and 581 municipalities (REFNIS codes). Seed pass R001. Review 2026-10-24 (R006): 41 rows removed, 4 regraded; 64 supporters remain. The one poll (80% for a wealth tax above EUR 1m, Dedicated/Ipsos for Le Vif and CNCD-11.11.11, Oct 2023) was removed because the source page could not be read and no other source for it was found.

polls.question: Support for introducing a 'corona' tax on large fortunes in Belgium (the release gives this wording; the French-language press describes it as a tax on wealth above EUR 1 million). The same survey found 72% for a European tax on large assets.
polls.question_original: coronabelasting op grote vermogens in België
polls.commissioned_by: 11.11.11 and CNCD-11.11.11 (Barometer of International Solidarity 2021, with Knack)
polls.sample: 1,000 Belgians, online, representative; margin of error at most 3.1%
